entries.title: I Timothy 4:1
segments: ¶But the Spirit speaks expressly, that in latter times some shall apostatise from the faith, giving their mind to deceiving spirits and teachings of demons

entries.title: I Timothy 4:2
segments: speaking lies in hypocrisy, cauterised as to their own conscience,

entries.title: I Timothy 4:3
segments: forbidding to marry, [bidding] to abstain from meats, which God has created for receiving with thanksgiving for them who are faithful and know the truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:4
segments: For every creature of God [is] good, and nothing [is] to be rejected, being received with thanksgiving;

entries.title: I Timothy 4:5
segments: for it is sanctified by God's word and freely addressing [him].

entries.title: I Timothy 4:6
segments: ¶Laying these things before the brethren, thou wilt be a good minister of Christ Jesus, nourished with the words of the faith and of the good teaching which thou hast fully followed up.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:7
segments: But profane and old wives' fables avoid, but exercise thyself unto piety;

entries.title: I Timothy 4:8
segments: for bodily exercise is profitable for a little, but piety is profitable for everything, having promise of life, of the present one, and of that to come.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:9
segments: The word [is] faithful and worthy of all acceptation;

entries.title: I Timothy 4:10
segments: for, for this we labour and suffer reproach, because we hope in a living God, who is preserver of all men, specially of those that believe.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:12
segments: Let no one despise thy youth, but be a model of the believers, in word, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:13
segments: Till I come, give thyself to reading, to exhortation, to teaching.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:14
segments: Be not negligent of the gift [that is] in thee, which has been given to thee through prophecy, with imposition of the hands of the elderhood.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:15
segments: Occupy thyself with these things; be wholly in them, that thy progress may be manifest to all.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:16
segments: Give heed to thyself and to the teaching; continue in them; for, doing this, thou shalt save both thyself and those that hear thee.
